$comment: Conductor launch settings — pass with `claude --settings .claude/conductor.settings.json`. Isolated to that launch; does NOT affect normal sessions. Enables agent teams + the no-mock PreToolUse gate. Continuation is owned by the persistent /goal (seeded by `experiment start`), NOT a Stop hook — a Stop hook here thrashes (it blocked every turn-end ~360x in one run, fighting /goal and inflating cache-reads). conductor-stop-check.sh is kept on disk but intentionally UNWIRED.
